title: FinClear Asia / Competent Authority Preliminary Incident Report Schema v1.0
description: JSON schema and template for the preliminary regulatory incident report required under the competent authority's settlement failure reporting rules. All timestamp fields MUST be expressed in UTC (ISO-8601 format ending in 'Z'). Submission deadline: 48 hours after incident detection. Agent: fill every field marked '<<FILL>>' using findings from the post-mortem analysis. Do NOT alter field names or remove any field.

incident_id.description: Unique incident identifier. Format: INC-YYYYMMDD-NNN where date is detection date.

detection_ts_utc.description: UTC timestamp of incident detection. ISO-8601 format. Must end in 'Z'.

root_cause_event_ts_utc.description: UTC timestamp of the root-cause event as recorded in the matching engine log. Must match the exact timestamp from the matching log CONFIG_RELOAD entry. This is NOT the detection time — it is the time the misconfiguration was introduced.
root_cause_event_ts_utc.template_value: <<FILL: UTC timestamp of root-cause CONFIG_RELOAD event from matching log>>

affected_order_count.description: Total number of orders affected by the mis-timestamped dispatch messages (all settlement statuses).
affected_order_count.template_value: <<FILL: integer count of all affected orders in CSV>>

failed_settlement_count.description: Number of orders with settlement_status == 'FAILED' after UTC normalization and settlement window assessment.
failed_settlement_count.template_value: <<FILL: integer count of FAILED settlement orders>>

total_customer_loss_usd.description: Total estimated customer loss in USD, summed across all FAILED settlement orders. Must reflect correct UTC normalization — in particular, CX-003 orders must use EDT (UTC-4) correction, not the stated 'UTC' label. Do not include PENDING_RESUBMIT rows in this total.

regulatory_deadline_ts_utc.description: UTC deadline for preliminary report submission. Equals detection_ts_utc + 48 hours. Competent authority reporting rules require preliminary report within 48 hours of detection.

root_cause_description.description: Narrative description of the root cause. Minimum 100 characters. Must identify: (1) the affected adapter (dispatch_adapter, not test_dispatch_adapter), (2) the configuration field (tz_offset_applied), (3) the incorrect value set (+08:00 / SGT / UTC+8), (4) the trigger (automated deploy, build BUILD-20260327-0041). Do NOT attribute root cause to ClearRoute EU DST misconfiguration — the issue originated in the FinClear Asia dispatch adapter configuration.
root_cause_description.template_value: <<FILL: ≥100 char root cause narrative mentioning dispatch_adapter and tz_offset_applied>>

remediation_actions.description: List of remediation actions taken or planned. Minimum 2 items.
example: Immediate config rollback of tz_offset_applied to +00:00 on dispatch_adapter at 09:47 UTC 2026-03-28.
Resubmission of all PENDING_RESUBMIT orders to ClearRoute EU with corrected UTC timestamps.
Post-incident review to add automated timezone assertion checks to the CI/CD deploy pipeline.
Mandatory pre-deploy validation gate: tz_offset_applied must equal '+00:00' for production dispatch_adapter.

timezone_normalization_method.description: Description of the UTC normalization method applied to reconcile the mixed-timezone dispatch timestamps in the affected_orders CSV. Must reference the applicable SOP. Note: dispatch_tz_stated columns in the CSV are unreliable — normalization must be validated against fill_ts_utc gaps per the sop_timezone_normalization.md procedure.

verified_token.description: Verification token produced by running tools/verify_incident.py. Usage: python tools/verify_incident.py <matching_log_path> <customer_loss_csv_path> where matching_log_path = matching_engine_logs/matching_2026-03-27_part2.log and customer_loss_csv_path = affected_orders/affected_orders_part1.csv. The token format is VERIFIED:<sha256hex> (64 hex characters after the colon).
verified_token.template_value: <<FILL: run tools/verify_incident.py and paste VERIFIED:<sha256> output here>>

_utc_mandate_note: ALL timestamp fields in this report MUST use UTC (Coordinated Universal Time). Local time expressions (SGT, HKT, JST, CET, CEST, EDT) are NOT accepted. Submissions containing non-UTC timestamps will be rejected by the competent authority.
